_: function:tide — the law of the tide family: it governs spine:tide, each holder voices a rung in their own mirror tide:<handle> at the rung's own address, and the fold reads every mirror at one address
1: A mirror line is the holder's own reading of the rung, in their own voice; silence at a rung is honest absence and is never filled.
2: The fold lays the mirrors side by side at one address and says where they agree and where they part; any reader computes it, and it is kept only by choice, at the bare name tide.
3: The room is pool:tide, the medium the family talks in — never one of its components.
